scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @readymeet/db generate && READYMEET_PRISMA_GENERATED=1 concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "corepack pnpm dev:livekit-realtime" "corepack pnpm --filter @readymeet/api dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @readymeet/assistant-service dev:watch" "corepack pnpm --filter @readymeet/meeting-agent dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @readymeet/web dev"
scripts.build:livekit-realtime: sh -c 'cd livekit-realtime && sh ./select-python.sh -m venv --clear .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt'
scripts.dev:livekit-realtime: sh -c 'cd livekit-realtime && exec sh ./select-python.sh -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir . --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4200'
scripts.dev:livekit-realtime:reload: sh -c 'cd livekit-realtime && exec sh ./select-python.sh -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir . --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4200'
scripts.start:api: corepack pnpm db:migrate && corepack pnpm start:api:server
scripts.start:livekit-realtime: sh -c 'cd livekit-realtime && exec sh ./select-python.sh -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir . --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4200'
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm typecheck:tooling && corepack pnpm -r typecheck
